name: Demotivational poster
summary: A black poster with a thin white frame, a photo, a large serif capital title and a small line of sad or dry text. It parodies the office motivational poster and spread on web forums from 2004.

philosophy.core_thesis: Turn the cheerful office poster into a dry joke: the same frame and layout, with a bleak caption.
design_principles: Fill the canvas with black (#000000) and keep a 6% to 8% margin around the picture.
Frame the picture with a 2px white line and a 3px gap of black between the picture and the line.
Set the title in white serif capitals at 56px to 72px, centred, 24px under the frame, with +0.12em tracking.
Set one line of caption in 18px serif at #C8C8C8, centred, 12px under the title.
Choose a photograph with one clear subject; desaturate it by 10% to 30% and crop it to 4:3.
Keep the total ratio near 4:5; the picture takes 66% to 72% of the height.
Write a title of one word and a caption of one sentence; the caption states a hard fact in a calm voice.
anti_patterns: More than two lines of caption
Busy collage instead of one subject

layout.grid_mechanics: A single centred column: frame, title, caption, on a canvas of 600px x 750px with a 48px margin.
layout.whitespace_ratio: Black fills 100% of the ground; the picture, the title and the caption take 70%, 12% and 6% of the height.
layout.alignment_rules: Everything is centred on one axis; the frame is symmetrical.
layout.container_geometry: Hard rectangles with a 0px radius; a 2px white outline around the photo.

font_pairings.note: Tinos has the metrics of Times, the classic face of the form.
A wider serif for a more formal title.

hierarchy_rules: Use one title size (64px) and one caption size (18px).
Set the title in bold (700) capitals.
Set the caption in regular (400) sentence case.
Use white for the title and light grey for the caption.

color.palette_structure: Black ground, white frame and title, grey caption, with a photograph as the only colour.
color.contrast_rules: White on black gives 21:1; grey #C8C8C8 on black gives 12:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat black with no gradient; the photograph carries all tone.
color.light_and_shadow: No shadow; light comes only from the photograph.

materiality.surface_simulation: A printed office poster on glossy stock, seen as a flat web image.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px white outline around the photo; no other border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; the layout stays flat.

ornamentation_details.iconography: No icons; a small line of text under the caption may carry a fake company name.
ornamentation_details.illustration: One photograph of a landscape, an animal or a group; a muted tone.

motion.transition_physics: Static image. A web version fades the caption in after 600ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts the frame by 2px and brightens the photo by 8%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer smiles at a calm, bleak joke in a serious frame.

avoid_when: The message must inspire without irony.

modifiers.how: Replace the frame and serif title with a full-bleed photo and white outlined capitals at top and bottom.
Use a white ground, a thin black line and a sans-serif title; keep the single picture.
Recompress the image, saturate it and add loud caption text; drop the frame.

pack.why: A thin outline family that stays quiet beside the serif title.

ground.why: The ground is black with a thin white frame, as on the poster.
